formattedAddress: No. 4號, Kinmen St, Dingdong Village, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan 100

displayName.text: 咖啡學人-老傑克 The Cafeist & Old Jack

text.text:
This cafe is a staple source of my beans for home brewing.
Their deep knowledge of roasting and brewing is shown both in their drinks and shared by their friendly and welcoming staff.
Their beans are very competitively priced, of great quality, roasted properly to express the origin while taming harsheness, come from a variety of under represented origins and most importantly are unapologetically faithful to the origin's flavor.
You'll always know it's a summatra blend because it'll give you that specific cocoa flavor.

If you want to drink pragmatic coffee where you get 90% of the quality for 60% of the price and explore the world from a bag of beans, this is it.
